data_quality_notes: RESEARCH COMPLETE — notes.md carries a RESEARCH COMPLETE block at 06:28 ET and a FINAL COUNTS block at 06:31 that supersedes it, so `truncated` is false and nothing was lost to the clock. Research ran 06:01-06:31 ET; the first candidate was captured at 06:05. Six distinct candidates from ten captured lines (FSLR, HII, VST and TLT were each recaptured after refinement; the last entry per symbol is used), against fourteen rejections logged with full working. PRICES — THE ONE CAVEAT THAT MATTERS MOST TODAY. Every price in this report is the 2026-11-03 close. A 06:26 ET re-quote of all six finalists returned exactly the figures research fetched at 06:06, each stamped 2026-11-03T21:00Z in the pre-market session; at 6am ET that is the freshest honest equity price, not stale data. But Democrats swept both chambers overnight, and renewables, managed care and defence were all reported moving 1-9% pre-open, so TODAY'S GAP IS IN NONE OF THESE NUMBERS. Research deliberately published no idea on any name reported gapping 5-9% (ENPH, MOH, CNC) rather than set levels against a price that no longer exists. FSLR is the single exception and it is handled with a limit shelf below the prior close plus an explicit instruction to abandon the idea if it opens above 187.60. FAILED SOURCES. `market_data.py macro` lost every index and commodity quote this run - SPX, NDX, Dow, Russell 2000, VIX, ES and NQ futures, DXY, gold and WTI all failed, because Finnhub requires a CFD subscription for indices and Yahoo returned HTTP 429 on every retry. Only bonds_20y (TLT 81.11) returned, and FRED carried the entire rates picture. So there is no index level, no VIX and no dollar in market_context.levels, and the oil figures there come from news coverage rather than a fetch - they are labelled as such and should not be treated as quoted prices. Kalshi returned ok with count 0 on all six queries (Congress, Fed, CPI, inflation, recession, Bitcoin), so there is no event contract on the one morning of the year when the election would have been the natural expression, and the open KXCPIYOY-26SEP-T3.5 position could not be checked either. Yahoo options returned HTTP 401, so no options-implied move was checked on any candidate, and Nasdaq short interest timed out, so there is no short-interest read on the top idea. CORRELATION - at the cap, stated rather than hidden. FSLR and TLT are the two new ideas and both trace to the 2026-11-03 divided-government result, by genuinely different mechanisms: Section 45X can no longer be repealed by legislation, and no further deficit-financed tax cut can pass. HII and LULU also key off the same result but are defensive amendments to existing exposure, not new bets. A third election-driven long, CNC, was researched to the primary document and rejected on the long_term floor; ARRY was rejected on the cap for sharing both FSLR's driver and its sector. No fourth election idea was added. If the market simply decides gridlock is bullish-everything or bearish-everything, FSLR and TLT move together. RATIOS - recomputed from the final entry, target and downside rather than carried from the notes: FSLR 2.13, VST 2.71, TLT 3.27. They are not clustered just above the floor, which is the signature of targets fitted to clear it, and no stop is doing the work: FSLR's sits 2.05 ATR from entry against a 2.0 floor, VST's 2.10 against 2.0, TLT's 1.82 against the 1.8 ETF floor. VST's target was fixed the honest way during the falsification pass - the original 161.00 was entry plus twice the risk and appears nowhere in the fetched history, so it was replaced by the 171.35 120-day high. That asks for a ~30% move inside a swing horizon, which is a large ask and is stated in its own counter-argument; the stop was not tightened to rescue the ratio, and the correct destination if that move is judged unreachable is the watchlist rather than a nudged target. THE THREE POSITION AMENDMENTS WILL FAIL MECHANICAL VALIDATION, AND TWO OF THEM SHOULD. HII (rank 2) will fail direction_consistency because its stop of 296.50 sits above its entry of 262.00. That is a trailing stop being set on a filled position now +20.9%, not a bad number, and the entry cannot be restated because the position was bought at a price. BCC at 0.90 and LULU at -0.21 fail the reward-to-risk floor and fail expectancy, and that negative expectancy is the finding rather than a defect: one is a wind-down and the other is a cover instruction, and an exit is supposed to have no edge. The risk is mechanical - Phase 2d demotes a failing idea to the watchlist with a note generated from the failure reasons, which would delete the actual instruction, and a demoted idea never reaches merge_report, so the stop would not reach the position tracker either. All three instructions are therefore also written into the watchlist in full as a backstop, labelled as such. If they survive validation, the watchlist lines are redundant and harmless; if they do not, the reader still gets the instruction. SIZING AND CONVICTION. FSLR is conviction 5 on five distinct kinds of evidence but sized at 3% rather than the 4-5% that tier allows, because it ran 174.40 to 185.90 in the two sessions into the election and part of the gridlock read is already paid for. BCC's three evidence kinds would support conviction 4 and it is published at 2 on purpose: every one of those confirmations argues the thesis is broken, not that the stock is a buy, so the score should not be raised. Every other conviction score equals its count of distinct evidence kinds. No claimed edge over the break-even hit rate exceeds 20 points; the largest is TLT at +12.6. EMPTY LANES, and why each is empty rather than skipped. No long_term idea: CNC was the best-evidenced idea of the morning and still fails the 2.5 floor, because the honest bear case of ~$45 (1.0x book, if the eAPTCs lapse and the Medicaid benefits ratio stays near 92.7%) would demand a $120.25 target from a 66.50 entry, or 2.68x book, which could not be defended - and walking the bear case up to the 56.67 120-day low to make the ratio work is exactly the reverse-engineering the floor exists to prevent. EQT and AR were rejected because the EIA contradicts the premise. No small or mid cap: the lane got a full second pass after the first RESEARCH COMPLETE block, and CENX, BILL, FTDR and ACIW were all rejected on the same geometry - a name reporting tomorrow that sits within ~5% of its 120-day high cannot carry an honest 2.0 ATR stop and still clear a 2.0 reward-to-risk floor. No crypto: quoted, but with no dated catalyst, no level work and no mechanism carrying the election read into it, and manufacturing one to fill the asset class would be padding. No futures: every futures and index quote failed, so nothing could be levelled. No event contract: dead source, not a judgement. OPEN POSITIONS. All 14 were reviewed and decided; the 11 holds are recorded with reasons in the 06:17 ET block of notes.md and are not re-litigated here. Two deserve a reader's attention anyway. CVS (open at 93.00, last 91.41) reports Q3 today before the open, and after the Q2 beat-and-raise the stock still fell 8.6%, so a beat is not protective and a gap can jump the 85.40 stop. UNP (last 303.43) is 4.1% from a 315.99 target that is also the exact 120-day high - the plan is to trim there rather than extend it. PFE and XLE both had their theses strengthened by the election result and were deliberately not re-pitched, having been recommended five times each in ten days. TRACK RECORD, used honestly. 4 of 34 closed trades have hit target (12%) at an average of -5.3%, and stocks are 1 of 21. The sample is past the ~15-trade noise threshold overall but not within any single bucket, so it is not over-fitted here; what it does justify is the stop-distance discipline above and the refusal to pad the count. Five of this report's six ideas are swing stocks, which is the worst-performing bucket on record. RED TEAM (phase 2c). Cut three of six and kept three. FSLR was cut from rank 1 and conviction 5 on the one thing research itself named as the morning's biggest caveat: the overnight gap happened. A real-time Nasdaq book at 06:32 ET shows FSLR 200.55 (bid 200.04 / ask 200.89, isRealTime true) against the 185.90 close used throughout this report - +7.9%, and 6.9% above the 187.60 line the idea itself set as the point past which it must be abandoned. The 45X gridlock thesis is right and was repriced in a single gap. VST was cut from rank 3 for the documented KRE failure: its 2.71:1 came from walking the stop in from the standing 112.14 (2.87 ATR, in force since 2026-10-25) to 117.50 (2.10 ATR) at an unchanged 132.00 entry. At the standing stop the ratio is 1.98:1, under the 2.0 floor - the idea never cleared it, and the pending position's stop is deliberately left at 112.14 rather than tightened. LULU was moved to the watchlist as an ACTION-REQUIRED cover instruction rather than left as a 'sell' row that reads like an invitation to open a short; the red team also removed the 103.00 'target' synthesis had written on a short entered at 100.61, because price trading there would have been graded target_hit at a 2.4% loss and put a cover-at-a-loss in the win column. TLT's target was cut 85.20 -> 84.30: the 5% duration move had been applied to the 81.11 close rather than to the 80.30 entry, flattering the reward with a price the idea refuses to pay. Recomputed off the entry the ratio is 2.67:1 and still clears the floor, so the idea survives the correction instead of depending on the error. HII was downgraded 4 -> 3 because two of its three evidence kinds are the same Nasdaq history fetch read twice. Three ideas remain: TLT, HII, BCC. TWO THINGS THE OPERATOR MUST KNOW. (1) HII and BCC are position updates, not entries, and phase 2d will read them as entries and demote both - HII because a protective stop at 296.50 sits above the immutable 262.00 fill, BCC because an exit plan priced off the 76.50 fill computes as 0.9:1. Their instructions are the valuable part of this report and are the two amendments that must reach state/open_positions.json: HII is a filled +20.9% long carrying stop null, and BCC is a filled long carrying stop null against a 110.0 target whose thesis the Q3 miss contradicted. If 2d demotes them, APPLY BOTH STOPS BY HAND - 296.50 on HII, 70.40 on BCC with the target cut to 82.00. (2) Every recommendation's cited Nasdaq history URL was the parameterless api.nasdaq.com endpoint, which 404s and failed the sources check on all six ideas; it is replaced on the survivors with the www.nasdaq.com market-activity page for the same series, verified 200. market_context.summary: Democrats are projected to take both chambers in the 2026-11-03 midterms - House 245+ seats and Senate 51+ on the CNBC election desk tally - with Trump remaining president, so divided government and legislative gridlock are seated for two years. Futures fell hard on the first results (S&P -1.1%, NDX -2%) then reversed and were higher pre-market, with reported pre-open readings disagreeing by timestamp between Dow +1.28%/S&P +0.90% and Dow +0.6%/S&P +0.2%. The durable read is a removal of risk premium rather than new stimulus: a Democratic Congress cannot pass drug-pricing or PBM legislation over a Republican president, and a Republican Congress can no longer repeal what remains of the IRA clean-energy credits, so both tails are legislatively closed - while tariffs and Section 232 remain executive and untouched. Managed care and hospitals were reported up (MOH +6.3%, CNC +4.7%), renewables leading, hyperscalers and defence down. Rates: the 10-year at 4.91% sits 103bp above an effective fed funds rate of 3.88% with the curve at +0.34 and unemployment turning up to 4.2%, and the 10-year fell from 4.97% to 4.89% as results came in. Oil is elevated against a war backdrop. No index, VIX, futures or dollar quote could be fetched this run, so the tape is described from news coverage and the rates picture comes entirely from FRED.

recommendations.thesis: The 10-year at 4.91% sits 103bp above an effective fed funds rate of 3.88% while unemployment has turned up to 4.2% from 4.1%, so the long end is carrying a wide term premium into a softening labour market. The election removes the fiscal tail that premium was partly paying for: neither further Republican tax cuts nor Democratic spending can pass a divided Congress, so the marginal path of Treasury supply flattens for two years, and the 10-year moved from 4.97% to 4.89% on the results.
recommendations.key_risk: The strongest objection is unanswered rather than rebutted: strategists reading the same result flag 2027 debt-ceiling mechanics under divided government as a reason term premium stays high, and gridlock does nothing about the existing debt stock. If the premium is about the stock rather than the flow of new legislation, this trade has no edge at all. Second, the 78.80 stop is 1.82 ATR from entry on an ATR14 of 0.82 - it clears the 1.8 ATR floor for a swing ETF only barely, and it is a real level (below the 2026-10-14 close of 78.89 and the 2026-10-19 low of 79.34) rather than a round number, but it sits under the 2.25 ATR band where this report's stop-outs have clustered. Size accordingly; this is the half-size first fill for that reason.
recommendations.counter_argument: Treasury yields have no consistent historical pattern around midterms, and inflation, Fed policy and growth remain the actual drivers - several strategists called the result short-term noise rather than a repricing. TLT has also already run 77.14 to 81.11 since 2026-10-07, so the easy part of any rate rally has happened, which is why this is a limit bid into the moving averages and not a market order. Note too that the 84.30 target is a duration calculation rather than a chart level, and it sits well below the 87.79 120-day high, so it is the conservative of the two available anchors. Red team cut this target from the 85.20 synthesis published: that figure applied the 5% duration move to the 81.11 close rather than to the 80.30 entry, which flattered the ratio by anchoring the reward on a price this idea explicitly refuses to pay. Recomputed off the entry the move is worth 84.30 and the ratio is 2.67:1, which still clears the 2.0:1 floor - the idea survives the correction rather than depending on the error.
